candidate: Exact prior batch-specific800us v7 coalescing candidate, no source edits or policy retuning.
source_identity: Reuse the same128-input candidate manifest and saved executable as the initial batch screen. Both source hashes and saved binary hashes are checked before scoring.
user_direction: if throughput, p99 better then worth keep
assessment: Throughput and p99 determine benefit. CPU, RSS, sync count and V4 controls remain reported diagnostics; a small CPU increase is not an automatic veto. Preserve the earlier zero-CPU gate/result as historical, rather than retroactively rewriting it.
retention: Provisional retention requires all six cells complete with identical DATA byte counts, each V7 cell paired and separate-arm median throughput>=0.95 and paired p99<=1.10, and independent batch8 confirmation paired throughput>1.00 plus p99<1.00. The original screen is separate corroborating evidence. CPU is not a retention gate. Failed/noisy V4 controls limit causal interpretation and do not qualify RFC default adoption.
configuration: Same ext4 SSD,1KiB values,2GiB SST,explicit v4/v7Parallel, fresh databases. Point1=20k/sample10,point8/16=100k/sample100;batch64=750k/sample10. One warmup per arm and3 alternating four-arm rounds per cell.30s initialcooldown,10s intercommand.
execution: Run all six remaining cells even if a performance guard fails. Stop only for benchmark/correctness errors or detected competing work. Preserve every completed record and failed controls. No score-selected reruns; no new candidate or profiles. No build/test/profile during scoring.
validation: Exact source/binary restored from prior candidate. Reuse byte-identical full1971-test and12-focused-test logs; no code changes require a rebuild. Final spelling, source reconstruction, raw/command/audit validation, summary regeneration and live source/executable checks before local commits.
